answer: Proof of Stake acts as a prism through which capital is refracted into network influence, ensuring that Sybil resistance scales with economic skin in the game. An attacker cannot simply mirror identities to manipulate consensus, as each node must stake tokens that are as fragile as a willow branch under slashing penalties. This mechanism imposes a direct financial cost: to inflate one’s influence, an attacker must acquire and lock substantial liquidity, rendering identity duplication prohibitively expensive.
